history.value: The 22 Act 1 pack cards (content/packs/act1-ironclad.json, base versions) zero-shot on tight2 held-out elite and boss cells (167 cells, 3 fights each, three copies in place of Strikes then Defends, paired by cell with the deck without them): the 10-29 net @hpb0.01 one turn deep minus the heuristic, lead with the card minus lead without, wins, se over cells at most 0.038. With @tsl1, 19 cards level and three in-turn exhaust skills cost: Disarm -0.118 (0.032) wins, -2.16 (0.48) HP; Impervious -0.122 (0.034), -1.58 (0.63); Intimidate -0.062 (0.029), -1.08 (0.40); mostly in elite cells. Berserk, predicted to cost on the plain leaf, leads instead: +0.070 (0.032) plain, +0.066 (0.033) tsl1, +0.33 in boss cells; both players lose wins with it (net -0.094, heuristic -0.160, which plays it on 15% of held turns), and tsl1 does not change the net's Berserk wins. Status-later, unreadable-trigger and new-atom (C1) cards all level. Lead reads hide cards bad for both players (Burning Pact -0.21, Exhume -0.17 wins for the net). Why the three cost is a hypothesis (inputs outside training range: negative enemy Strength, Weak on all enemies, 30 block), not read.
